consents_titular.name: consents_titular
consents_titular.value: "consents"."user_id" is not null or ("consents"."patient_id" is not null and "consents"."tenant_id" is not null)

invites_alvo.name: invites_alvo
invites_alvo.value:
("invites"."tipo" = 'nutri' and "invites"."user_id" is not null and "invites"."patient_id" is null)
       or ("invites"."tipo" = 'paciente' and "invites"."user_id" is null and "invites"."tenant_id" is not null and "invites"."patient_id" is not null)

appointments_link_online.name: appointments_link_online
appointments_link_online.value: ("appointments"."modalidade" = 'presencial' and "appointments"."link_online" is null) or ("appointments"."modalidade" = 'online' and "appointments"."link_online" is not null and "appointments"."link_online" ~ '^https://\S+$' and char_length("appointments"."link_online") <= 500)

appointments_cancelamento_completo.name: appointments_cancelamento_completo
appointments_cancelamento_completo.value: ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelada') = ("appointments"."cancelado_por" is not null and "appointments"."cancelada_em" is not null)

food_measures_nome_tamanho.name: food_measures_nome_tamanho
food_measures_nome_tamanho.value: char_length("food_measures"."nome") between 2 and 60 and char_length("food_measures"."plural") between 2 and 60

foods_proprio_completo.name: foods_proprio_completo
foods_proprio_completo.value: "foods"."tenant_id" is null or ("foods"."kcal" is not null and "foods"."proteina_g" is not null and "foods"."carboidrato_g" is not null and "foods"."lipidio_g" is not null and "foods"."fibra_g" is not null)

foods_valores_faixa.name: foods_valores_faixa
foods_valores_faixa.value: coalesce("foods"."kcal", 0) between 0 and 900 and coalesce("foods"."proteina_g", 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce("foods"."carboidrato_g", 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce("foods"."lipidio_g", 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce("foods"."fibra_g", 0) between 0 and 100

foods_grupo_valido.name: foods_grupo_valido
foods_grupo_valido.value: "foods"."grupo" in ('Cereais e derivados', 'Verduras, hortaliças e derivados', 'Frutas e derivados', 'Gorduras e óleos', 'Pescados e frutos do mar', 'Carnes e derivados', 'Leite e derivados', 'Bebidas (alcoólicas e não alcoólicas)', 'Ovos e derivados', 'Produtos açucarados', 'Miscelâneas', 'Outros alimentos industrializados', 'Alimentos preparados', 'Leguminosas e derivados', 'Nozes e sementes')

contents_textos_tamanho.name: contents_textos_tamanho
contents_textos_tamanho.value: char_length("contents"."titulo") between 1 and 120 and char_length("contents"."resumo") <= 300 and char_length("contents"."corpo_md") <= 20000

contents_video_completo.name: contents_video_completo
contents_video_completo.value: ("contents"."video_provider" is null) = ("contents"."video_id" is null) and ("contents"."tipo" <> 'video' or "contents"."video_id" is not null) and ("contents"."tipo" <> 'orientacao' or "contents"."video_id" is null)

contents_video_id_valido.name: contents_video_id_valido
contents_video_id_valido.value: "contents"."video_id" is null or ("contents"."video_provider" = 'youtube' and "contents"."video_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$') or ("contents"."video_provider" = 'vimeo' and "contents"."video_id" ~ '^[0-9]{6,12}(/[0-9a-f]{6,20})?$')

document_access_codes_sessao.name: document_access_codes_sessao
document_access_codes_sessao.value: ("document_access_codes"."sessao_hash" is null) = ("document_access_codes"."sessao_expira_em" is null) and ("document_access_codes"."sessao_hash" is null or "document_access_codes"."usado_em" is not null)

signed_documents_emitido_com_pdf.name: signed_documents_emitido_com_pdf
signed_documents_emitido_com_pdf.value: "signed_documents"."anonimizado_em" is not null or (("signed_documents"."pdf_path" is not null and "signed_documents"."pdf_sha256" is not null and "signed_documents"."assinado_em" is not null and "signed_documents"."assinatura_tipo" is not null) = ("signed_documents"."status" in ('assinado','substituido','cancelado')))

signed_documents_sha256_formato.name: signed_documents_sha256_formato
signed_documents_sha256_formato.value: ("signed_documents"."pdf_sha256" is null or "signed_documents"."pdf_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and ("signed_documents"."base_pdf_sha256" is null or "signed_documents"."base_pdf_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

signed_documents_arquivos_do_tenant.name: signed_documents_arquivos_do_tenant
signed_documents_arquivos_do_tenant.value: ("signed_documents"."base_pdf_path" is null or starts_with("signed_documents"."base_pdf_path", "signed_documents"."tenant_id"::text || '/documento_base/')) and ("signed_documents"."pdf_path" is null or starts_with("signed_documents"."pdf_path", "signed_documents"."tenant_id"::text || '/documento_assinado/'))

exam_submissions_nome_tamanho.name: exam_submissions_nome_tamanho
exam_submissions_nome_tamanho.value: "exam_submissions"."nome" is null or char_length("exam_submissions"."nome") between 1 and 120

exam_submissions_arquivo_valido.name: exam_submissions_arquivo_valido
exam_submissions_arquivo_valido.value: "exam_submissions"."arquivo_path" is null or ("exam_submissions"."status" in ('recebido', 'cancelado') and "exam_submissions"."arquivo_path" like "exam_submissions"."tenant_id"::text || '/exame/%')

exam_submissions_recusa.name: exam_submissions_recusa
exam_submissions_recusa.value: ("exam_submissions"."status" = 'recusado') = ("exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa" is not null) and ("exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa" is null or "exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa" in ('ilegivel', 'nao_e_exame', 'outra_pessoa', 'repetido', 'outro'))

exam_submissions_recusa_texto.name: exam_submissions_recusa_texto
exam_submissions_recusa_texto.value: ("exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa_texto" is not null) = ("exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa" is not distinct from 'outro') and ("exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa_texto" is null or char_length("exam_submissions"."motivo_recusa_texto") between 1 and 300)

exam_submissions_revisao.name: exam_submissions_revisao
exam_submissions_revisao.value: ("exam_submissions"."status" in ('aceito', 'recusado')) = ("exam_submissions"."revisado_em" is not null) and ("exam_submissions"."revisado_em" is null) = ("exam_submissions"."revisado_por" is null)

exam_submissions_falha.name: exam_submissions_falha
exam_submissions_falha.value: ("exam_submissions"."status" = 'falhou') = ("exam_submissions"."motivo_falha" is not null) and ("exam_submissions"."motivo_falha" is null or "exam_submissions"."motivo_falha" in ('conversao', 'paginas', 'cota', 'interrompido'))

ia_tarefas_conteudo_esvaziado.name: ia_tarefas_conteudo_esvaziado
ia_tarefas_conteudo_esvaziado.value: "ia_tarefas"."status" in ('na_fila', 'processando', 'pronta') or ("ia_tarefas"."parametros" is null and "ia_tarefas"."resultado" is null)

ia_uso_textos_tamanho.name: ia_uso_textos_tamanho
ia_uso_textos_tamanho.value: ("ia_uso"."recusa_categoria" is null or char_length("ia_uso"."recusa_categoria") <= 60) and ("ia_uso"."request_id" is null or char_length("ia_uso"."request_id") <= 200) and ("ia_uso"."inference_geo" is null or char_length("ia_uso"."inference_geo") <= 20)

admin_actions_alvo_coerente.name: admin_actions_alvo_coerente
admin_actions_alvo_coerente.value:
(("admin_actions"."acao" = 'reiniciar_2fa') = ("admin_actions"."alvo_user_id" is not null and "admin_actions"."alvo_papel" is not null))
          and (("admin_actions"."acao" in ('liberar_ia', 'bloquear_ia', 'ajustar_cota_ia')) = ("admin_actions"."alvo_tenant_id" is not null))
          and (("admin_actions"."acao" in ('liberar_ia', 'bloquear_ia', 'ajustar_cota_ia')) <= ("admin_actions"."alvo_user_id" is null and "admin_actions"."alvo_papel" is null))

tenants_fitoterapia_junta.name: tenants_fitoterapia_junta
tenants_fitoterapia_junta.value: ("tenants"."fitoterapia_registro" is null) = ("tenants"."fitoterapia_declarada_em" is null) and ("tenants"."fitoterapia_registro" is null) = ("tenants"."fitoterapia_termo_versao" is null)

patients_nascimento_e_sexo.name: patients_nascimento_e_sexo
patients_nascimento_e_sexo.value: "patients"."origem" = 'agendamento_publico' or "patients"."anonimizado_em" is not null or ("patients"."data_nascimento" is not null and "patients"."sexo" is not null)

patients_ia_aviso_junto.name: patients_ia_aviso_junto
patients_ia_aviso_junto.value: ("patients"."ia_aviso_versao" is null) = ("patients"."ia_aviso_em" is null) and ("patients"."ia_aviso_versao" is null) = ("patients"."ia_aviso_canal" is null)

diary_entries_refeicao_valida.name: diary_entries_refeicao_valida
diary_entries_refeicao_valida.value: "diary_entries"."refeicao" in ('Café da manhã', 'Lanche da manhã', 'Almoço', 'Lanche da tarde', 'Jantar', 'Ceia', 'Outro')

diary_entries_texto_tamanho.name: diary_entries_texto_tamanho
diary_entries_texto_tamanho.value: "diary_entries"."texto" is null or char_length("diary_entries"."texto") between 1 and 2000
